summary.finding: Thirty-seven mappings have two genuinely independent lineages proving the exact platform, version, publicBeta channel, displayed public ordinal, and America/Los_Angeles appearance date. Three mappings have only one such lineage because OS X Daily numbers a beta made available to both developer and public testers without displaying a public-beta ordinal.

reasonCodeDefinitions.APPROVED_EXACT_TWO_LINEAGES: Two independent publisher families prove every required identity field at claim level.
reasonCodeDefinitions.BLOCK_SECOND_EXACT_PUBLIC_ORDINAL_MISSIN: Only one independent lineage displays the required public-beta ordinal.
reasonCodeDefinitions.EXCLUDE_DEVELOPER_ORDINAL_GENERIC_PUBLIC: A developer ordinal plus a generic public-availability update does not prove the public ordinal.
reasonCodeDefinitions.EXCLUDE_BETA_NUMBER_WITH_PUBLIC_AUDIENCE: A generic beta number offered to public and developer testers does not display the public-program ordinal.
reasonCodeDefinitions.EXCLUDE_LOCAL_DATE_MISMATCH: A next-day local calendar row does not independently prove the earlier America/Los_Angeles date.
reasonCodeDefinitions.EXCLUDE_UNNUMBERED_PUBLIC_BETA: An unnumbered public-beta report does not establish Public Beta 1.
reasonCodeDefinitions.QUALIFY_DATED_HEADING_ONLY: Only the exact dated heading is selected; copied or mismatched body text is excluded.
reasonCodeDefinitions.QUALIFY_CONFLICTING_DATE: A conflicting date remains provenance and is not selected.
reasonCodeDefinitions.QUALIFY_VISIBLE_LOCAL_TIMESTAMP: A visible article timestamp is used where the structured publishedAt field is absent.
